description: Defines the InitialLoadingScreenClass for managing the loading screen UI component in a Mattermost web application, including start/stop behavior, animation handling, and cleanup.

classes.name: InitialLoadingScreenClass
classes.description: Manages the display and lifecycle of the initial loading screen, including animations, timing, and cleanup.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the loading screen component, binds event handlers, and starts the loading animation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Checks if running in desktop app; if not, sets up animation event listeners and starts the loading screen.

methods.name: handleAnimationEndEvent
methods.description: Handles the end of animation events to transition or destroy the loading screen.

methods.name: addAnimationEndListener
methods.description: Adds event listener for animation end events.

methods.name: removeAnimationEndListener
methods.description: Removes event listener for animation end events.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes loading screen elements and cleans up references.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the loading animation and displays the loading screen.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the loading animation, measures load time, and transitions to loaded state.
